verdict.rationale: The public guidance page links an amended tax and wage report form as a direct PDF, and the filing instructions are on open esd.wa.gov pages, so at least some forms and instructions can be downloaded without an account. However, the core quarterly report paper forms are mailed by the agency on request rather than offered as downloads. The EAMS filing host sits behind a SecureAccess Washington login. missing for 10: downloadable quarterly tax and wage report forms, evidence of a broader public forms library covering other employer filings, independent or hands-on confirmation that the PDF is reachable without login.
